name: Background Worker Talk To Me
author: AktOn1
description: Lets an AI agent that works on your desktop tell you first. Agents announce the hardware they need (the screen, heavy CPU/RAM, a big VM, the GPU) and a banner shows who uses what, with an optional queue. Also: a heads-up countdown (pause, postpone or cancel), a TESTING badge with the expected time, Ctrl-key answers or a typed reply returned to the command line, a guard that makes agents announce themselves, and a bar icon with all the settings.

barWidget.description: Who is using the screen, the CPU/RAM, a VM or the GPU right now, who waits in line, and every setting of the plugin.
